## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (Technology only); confirmation: extreme weak sector breadth and mixed megacap trends (some ABOVE TREND like MSFT/AMZN while AAPL/JPM/V are BELOW TREND), plus major megacap divergence suppresses a directional call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +3.93%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials weak: BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND; Industrials weak: UPS (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.79%) BELOW TREND, UNP (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +8.54% | 1M: -7.53%) RECOVERY; ROST (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +11.63%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +6.43% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND; FDX (1W: -5.65% | 1M: -2.25%) BELOW TREND; ECL (1W: -5.72% | 1M: -3.08%) BELOW TREND; UNP (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -16.11%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.54% | 1M: -7.53%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence among megacaps (NVDA, GOOGL, INTC, AMD with 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical moves, not confirmation of a broad trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is the only sector positive (1/11 sectors positive) and showing mixed internals: AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -0.35%) RECOVERY and GOOGL (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -4.83%) RECOVERY — sector strength concentrated in a handful of names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are broadly weak: BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND — sector rotation away from financials is evident with limited pockets of resilience.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed-to-weak: JNJ (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND — watch for idiosyncratic news-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, favor selective exposure to ABOVE TREND tech names (AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND) and DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to weak Financials (JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND) and broad Industrials underperformers.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +6.43% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY — momentum into chip conversations; TSLA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -2.89%) RECOVERY — China strength noted.  
BEARISH: JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND — headlines pressuring credit exposure; BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND — monitor flows.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (only sector positive; watch AVGO/SHOP internals).  
BEARISH: Financials and Industrials (broad 1W weakness; multiple large names BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AVGO near prior resistance — watch follow-through above short-term highs; NVDA RECOVERY needs confirmation with 1M re-acceleration; JPM below trend — watch 1M downside continuation as risk trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GM (+85): GM headline on EPS beat/dividend and buyback; price not in top performers list here — monitor for follow-through.  
JNJ (+85): JNJ (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION on FDA combo approval headlines — sentiment confirmed by 1M strength but 1W pullback.  
AMD (+50): AMD (1W: +6.43% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY on AI memory chip talks — positive sentiment aligns with strong 1W momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
SBUX (-55): SBUX (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND with negative sentiment — divergence (execution concerns vs. price strength), watch for distribution.  
JPM (-45): JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms fundamental/credit chatter.  
BLK (-45): BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment confirmed by price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap divergence (NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -0.35%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -4.83%) RECOVERY) and sentiment/price divergences (SBUX negative news but ABOVE TREND) — monitor for trend confirmation.
